title: Endostrat: a multicenter study of AI-assisted two-level risk stratification for gastric precancerous and early neoplastic lesion screening.
summary: In a retrospective three-center cohort of 8,829 patients, the two-stage Endostrat AI system stratified gastric precancerous and early-neoplastic lesion risk. This is retrospective screening-risk validation, not prospective clinical benefit.
ai_technology: Endostrat is a two-stage AI system for gastric-lesion risk stratification.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Retrospective multicenter validation in 8,829 patients across three centers; prospective screening outcomes were not tested.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study; author affiliation is not stated in the reviewed material.
